For more information please visit : www.thecarriageworksdublin.ie

2 Bedroom Apartment Space to Live and Grow

Our two-bedroom apartments at The Carriageworks are ideal for sharers, small families, or anyone needing extra space. Each home features a bright open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, two spacious double bedrooms one ensuite, with built-in wardrobes, and a modern main bathrooms with rainfall shower and contemporary fixtures. A dedicated utility room with a washer/dryer makes everyday living easy, while smart heating controls and high-speed broadband ensure comfort and connectivity. These apartments offer the perfect balance of comfort, style, and convenience in a central Dublin location.

Amenities at The Carriageworks:
Residents enjoy FREE high-speed WiFi, a rooftop sauna and ice bath, contrast hydro showers, rooftop wellness area, premium gym & studio space, a reception and concierge, residents' clubhouse, co-working spaces, coffee dock, a resident app, car sharing club, and regular community events and pets are welcome*—all designed to make city living easy, healthy, and enjoyable.
*T&C's for Pets.
